author: UNTILS
name: UntilsSDK
shortDescription: Save progress, gameplay events, pause handling and share links for games published on UNTILS.
description: The UNTILS SDK for GDevelop. Add it to your project, run the action "Start UNTILS SDK" in your first scene, and your game can save progress for players and talk to UNTILS. The UNTILS HTML SDK is included, there is nothing else to download. Works in the HTML5 export. Docs: https://developer.untils.in/docs/

eventsFunctions.description: Starts the UNTILS SDK and loads the saved data. Run it once, in the first scene, at the start. Then wait for the condition "UNTILS SDK is ready".
eventsFunctions.name: Start
eventsFunctions.sentence: Start UNTILS SDK (pause the game and sound when the tab is hidden: _PARAM1_)

parameters.description: Pause the game and mute the sound when the tab is hidden
parameters.name: AutoPause

eventsFunctions.description: True when the SDK has started and the saved data is loaded.
eventsFunctions.name: IsReady

eventsFunctions.description: True when the game runs on untils.in. False when you test it on your own computer (saves then go to your browser).
eventsFunctions.name: IsOnUntils
eventsFunctions.sentence: The game is running on UNTILS

eventsFunctions.description: Tell UNTILS that the game starts loading more content (optional).
eventsFunctions.name: LoadingStart

eventsFunctions.description: Tell UNTILS that loading is finished and the menu is ready. Do it when your first menu is shown.
eventsFunctions.name: LoadingFinished

eventsFunctions.description: The player starts really playing. Call it when a level or round begins.
eventsFunctions.name: GameplayStart

eventsFunctions.description: The player stops playing: game over, menu or pause. Repeated calls are ignored.
eventsFunctions.name: GameplayStop

eventsFunctions.description: True while the tab is hidden or the app is switched away.
eventsFunctions.name: IsPaused
eventsFunctions.sentence: The game is paused by UNTILS (tab hidden)

eventsFunctions.description: Saves a number under a name. It is stored for the player on UNTILS (about 900 KB per game).
eventsFunctions.name: SaveNumber

eventsFunctions.description: Saves a text under a name. It is stored for the player on UNTILS (about 900 KB per game).
eventsFunctions.name: SaveText

eventsFunctions.description: Deletes one saved value.
eventsFunctions.name: DeleteKey

eventsFunctions.description: Deletes everything saved for this game.
eventsFunctions.name: DeleteAll

eventsFunctions.description: True when something is saved under this name.
eventsFunctions.name: HasKey

eventsFunctions.description: Gives the saved number, or the default when nothing is saved yet.
eventsFunctions.name: LoadNumber

parameters.description: Number to use when nothing is saved
parameters.name: Default

eventsFunctions.description: Gives the saved text, or the default when nothing is saved yet.
eventsFunctions.name: LoadText

parameters.description: Text to use when nothing is saved
parameters.name: Default

eventsFunctions.description: Asks UNTILS to enter fullscreen. Use it from a button press.
eventsFunctions.name: RequestFullscreen

eventsFunctions.description: Asks UNTILS to leave fullscreen.
eventsFunctions.name: ExitFullscreen

eventsFunctions.description: True when the player uses a phone or a tablet.
eventsFunctions.fullName: Player is on a phone or tablet
eventsFunctions.name: IsMobile
eventsFunctions.sentence: The player is on a phone or tablet

eventsFunctions.description: The player's name. Everyone is Guest for now.
eventsFunctions.name: PlayerName

eventsFunctions.description: The language code of the player, for example en or hi.
eventsFunctions.name: Language

eventsFunctions.description: Reads a value from a share link that was made with the SDK (empty when it is not there).
eventsFunctions.name: UrlParameter

eventsFunctions.description: Sends your own event, for example level_complete. Name up to 40 characters. Stats come later.
eventsFunctions.name: Track

eventsFunctions.description: Ads are not live yet, so the game simply continues. When ads go live, your game already works.
eventsFunctions.name: ShowInterstitialAd

eventsFunctions.description: The version of the UNTILS HTML SDK inside this extension.
eventsFunctions.name: SDKVersion
